visual_action: Donald Trump speaks at a podium with flags in the background. The shot is a medium close-up of him. At the end of the video, there is a short, black-and-white montage showing the exterior of the White House and a helicopter, likely Marine One, on the lawn.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is the sole speaker in the video, shown in a close-up as he delivers a policy announcement.

on_screen_text.text: POTUS just declared fentanyl a Weapon of Mass Destruction.

spoken_summary: Donald Trump announces that he is signing an executive order to formally classify fentanyl as a 'weapon of mass destruction' to protect Americans from the 'scourge of deadly fentanyl flooding into our country.' He compares its deadliness to that of a bomb, stating it kills 200,000 to 300,000 people a year.
audio_music: The video features Donald Trump's spoken voice. At approximately 9 seconds, a serious, dramatic instrumental track begins playing underneath his speech and continues through the end of the video, enhancing the gravity of the announcement.
editing_pacing: The video primarily uses a static talking-head shot of Donald Trump. Quick, single-word text overlays flash on screen in sync with his speech. The clip concludes with a short, slow-paced montage of black-and-white B-roll.
central_claim: The Trump administration is taking historic and decisive action to combat the fentanyl crisis by officially classifying the drug as a weapon of mass destruction.
intended_effect: To frame the fentanyl crisis as a national security emergency and portray the administration as taking strong, necessary action to protect the country.
